evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE is the scan's list of [Unit] dependency directives, and the surrounding comments say the scan must read every co-installed unit because those directives can start or affect the selected unit. systemd v257 recognizes PropagatesStopTo= as a [Unit] directive: a co-installed unit with PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service can stop the selected unit when that unit is stopped. Because the regex omits it, the dependency scan can miss that relation and discovery can incorrectly report supported=True. StopPropagatedFrom= is the corresponding inverse relation. Completing the directive list is a routine correctness fix, not a new requirement.
